assets.scope: maze and sandworm-lair random pool (rarity 1), vermin/sandworm, non-unique

references.note: Approved disc, lighting and camera; do not copy its creature.
Native species shape: one slender glossy orange-tan worm lying in a smooth S-curve, small blunt head.
Shipped catalog vermin/sandworm: fat tan segmented coil with a toothy frilled maw and spined back. The plain sandworm must stay a slim smooth S-curve, not another coil with a big maw.

prompt_fields.subject: A single slender giant sandworm lying in one smooth open S-curve, glossy warm orange-tan segmented body of even thickness with fine ring-shaped segment lines, a small rounded blunt head with a modest round mouth (no large fangs, no frill, no spines, no armour plates), the tail tapering to a soft point. Low, smooth and unarmoured; the whole S-curve stays well inside the disc.
prompt_fields.contrast: Second vermin/sandworm catalog identity next to sandworm-queen (fat tan coil with toothy frilled maw and spined back) and, in the same family batch, sandworm destroyer (thick dark-armoured tight ring) and sandworm burrower (two green arches out of a sand heap). The plain sandworm is the slim open S-curve: long thin smooth silhouette, lightest warm orange-tan value of the sandworms, no armour and no spines.
prompt_fields.composition: One compact complete creature on a single circular tabletop disc, steep overhead three-quarter camera; visible clear neutral base ring on every side. Keep all anatomy and equipment well inside the inner four-fifths of disc radius. Base brightness must visually match reference neutral disc, with no illumination spill or ground effects. Disc plate discipline: measured results show generations of this style reference tend to render the disc DARKER than the reference, never lighter. So do not darken the disc at all: render the neutral disc -- including the whole outer-sixth ring band and the area under the creature -- at the style reference's own brightness, if anything a hair lighter, and never darker. No warm cast, glow, bounce-light, gradient or vignette anywhere on the disc. Do not darken the creature to compensate either. Add no warm cast, glow, bounce-light, gradient or vignette to the disc anywhere, including directly under or behind dark-bodied creatures.
prompt_fields.palette: Warm glossy orange-tan sand-coloured hide with paler cream segment lines and a slightly deeper orange belly edge, small dark round mouth; dry neutral charcoal disc with restrained copper-grey bevel, kept a visibly lighter value than the creature's darkest parts so the two never merge.
